catburger.configuration.CatBurger.toolti: Follower that restores food and protects from death while worn
catburger.configuration.DeathProtectionC: Death protection cooldown, applies to every follower
catburger.configuration.DeathProtectionE: Death protection while a follower is worn
catburger.configuration.FirstPersonDispl: First person display of your own followers
catburger.configuration.FollowDelay.tool: Trailing behind the wearer while moving
catburger.configuration.FormationMode.to: Settings for formation mode, where followers line up in a tail
Settings for independent mode, where each follower drifts on its own
catburger.configuration.MobPickup.toolti: Whether mobs can pick up and wear followers
catburger.configuration.MultipleFollower: How multiple followers worn by the same wearer are arranged
catburger.configuration.RadiusEffects.to: Effects applied to nearby mobs when death protection triggers
catburger.configuration.ScaleAndOffset.t: Size and position of the follower relative to the wearer's eyes; offsets follow the orbit direction set by spring motion or rotation, not the follower's facing
catburger.configuration.SpringMotion.too: Spring motion for orbiting, overrides rotation when enabled
catburger.configuration.TickEffects.tool: Effects that trigger repeatedly while the follower is worn
catburger.configuration.TurningAndFacing: How the follower orbits and faces when the wearer turns or looks around
Whether other mobs are affected, meaning creatures that are neither the wearer, nor players, nor tamed pets
catburger.configuration.affectPets.toolt: Whether tamed pets are affected, meaning any creature with an owner
catburger.configuration.affectSelf.toolt: Whether the wearer itself is affected
catburger.configuration.cooldownDuration: Ticks before death protection can trigger again, 0 disables the cooldown
catburger.configuration.crouchOffset.too: Extra blocks to move up while sneaking, negative moves down
catburger.configuration.deathProtectionE: Trigger when the wearer takes fatal damage
catburger.configuration.deduplicateRende: Render only one follower of each kind when the same follower is worn in several slots
catburger.configuration.effects.tooltip: One entry per line, formatted as effect|duration|amplifier; amplifier 0 is level I, up to 255
catburger.configuration.floatCycleDurati: Ticks for one full float cycle
catburger.configuration.floatDistance.to: Height in blocks between the highest and lowest point of the float
catburger.configuration.followSpeed.tool: How quickly the follower catches up, higher values give a shorter trail, 1.0 follows instantly
catburger.configuration.followerRenderMo: Independent scatters them loosely around the configured position, formation lines them up in a tail where each follows the one ahead
catburger.configuration.foodLevelRestora: Ticks between restorations, 0 restores every tick
Restoration stops once it reaches this value
catburger.configuration.formationGazeTar: Where each follower in the tail looks: along the wearer's view, or at the follower ahead of it
catburger.configuration.formationSpacing: Blocks between each follower and the one ahead of it
Blocks to move forward along the orbit direction, negative moves backward
catburger.configuration.gazeAtViewTarget: Aim the follower worn by a player at that player's own crosshair hit point, using the setting they synced to the server; followers on non-player wearers use this local setting
catburger.configuration.independentFloat: Give each follower its own float rhythm and period instead of floating in sync
Blocks to move to the right of the orbit direction, negative moves left
catburger.configuration.maxLagDistance.t: Maximum distance in blocks the follower trails behind, 0 disables trailing
catburger.configuration.mobPickupEnabled: Allow mobs to pick up and wear followers
catburger.configuration.nightVisionInter: Ticks between refreshes, 0 refreshes every tick; keep it well below the effect duration or the effect expires and flickers
catburger.configuration.orientationFollo: How quickly the facing catches up with its target, higher is faster, 1.0 follows instantly
catburger.configuration.radius.tooltip: Radius in blocks around the wearer
catburger.configuration.renderScale.tool: Multiplied by the wearer's own scale
catburger.configuration.resetCooldownOnW: Waking up from sleep resets the cooldown
catburger.configuration.restoreHealth.to: In fixed value mode, restored to this value
catburger.configuration.restoreHealthPer: Health is restored to this percentage of max health
catburger.configuration.rotationFollowSp: How quickly the orbit catches up with the head, higher is faster, 1.0 follows instantly
catburger.configuration.showInFirstPerso: Show your own followers in first person
catburger.configuration.springDamping.to: Fraction of spring speed kept each tick, lower settles faster
catburger.configuration.springMotionEnab: Orbit with spring motion that can overshoot and bounce back
catburger.configuration.title: Cat Burger Configuration
catburger.configuration.useHealthPercent: Health is restored as a percentage of max health, otherwise to a fixed value
catburger.configuration.useShortestArc.t: Catch up along the shortest arc instead of following every full turn
catburger.configuration.verticalOffset.t: Blocks to move up from eye height, negative moves down
